description: Implementation of time zone handling functions for libc, including conversions between civil time and time_t, handling platform-specific timezone data, and transition calculations within the absl::time_internal::cctz namespace.

classes.name: TimeZoneLibC
classes.description: A class implementing time zone conversions and transition logic using libc functions.

methods.name: BreakTime
methods.description: Converts a time_point to a local or UTC civil time, including offset and abbreviation.

methods.name: MakeTime
methods.description: Converts civil seconds to time_t, considering daylight saving time flags.

methods.name: NextTransition
methods.description: Indicates if there is a next transition; always returns false for libc-based implementation.

methods.name: PrevTransition
methods.description: Indicates if there is a previous transition; always returns false for libc-based implementation.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns version info; here, always returns empty string.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the timezone ('localtime' or 'UTC').
